risk_assessment.headline_verdict: ELEVATED FLOOD WATCH: River Mahanadi & Kathajodi is rising; drainage networks under pressure.
risk_assessment.chain_of_thought_reasoning:
1. METEOROLOGICAL ANALYSIS: Light-to-moderate seasonal precipitation (18.5 mm/h) within nominal absorptive tolerances.
2. HYDRAULIC & RIVERINE STAGE: River water level (51.230 m) is safely 2.27 m below Danger Level (53.50 m).
3. TOPOGRAPHIC RUNOFF BEHAVIOR: Catchment terrain has low permeability (Loam, runoff coefficient 0.55, TWI 16.8), accelerating overland surge directly into drainage networks (choke ratio: 14%).
4. SPACEBORNE OBSERVATION: Clear sky condition (20% cloud); optical NDWI (-0.050) and SAR radar (-9.2 dB) corroborate surface water extent.
5. CROSS-DOMAIN SYNTHESIS: Multi-agent consensus weighted score evaluates to 0.478 with 90.2% sensor certainty. Conclusion: ELEVATED FLOOD WATCH: River Mahanadi & Kathajodi is rising; drainage networks under pressure.
